radio.text: Welcome to the Frontier. Sol Federation Central Stardock operational.
Prices on Equipment in Sector 4 are surging. Haulers, take note.
Voss Heavy Industries has completed another shield matrix expansion.
Federal patrol pigs can't reach this far out. Fresh plunder for the incinerator!

logs: Warp drive engaged. Navigated from Sector 1 to Sector 2.
